#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static long long MOD = 998244353;
static long long even, odd;
static unordered_map<long long, long long> dp0;
static unordered_map<long long, long long> dp1;

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (b != 0) {
        if (b & 1) {
            res = (res * a) % MOD;
        }
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long go(long long n, int x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        if (dp0.count(n)) return dp0[n];
        if (n == 1) {
            dp0[n] = even % MOD;
            return dp0[n];
        } else if (n == 2) {
            dp0[n] = (even * even % MOD + odd * odd % MOD) % MOD;
            return dp0[n];
        }
        long long a1 = go(n / 2, 0);
        long long a2 = go(n - n / 2, 0);
        long long b1 = go(n / 2, 1);
        long long b2 = go(n - n / 2, 1);
        dp0[n] = (a1 * a2 % MOD + b1 * b2 % MOD) % MOD;
        return dp0[n];
    } else {
        if (dp1.count(n)) return dp1[n];
        if (n == 1) {
            dp1[n] = odd % MOD;
            return dp1[n];
        } else if (n == 2) {
            dp1[n] = (even * odd % MOD + odd * even % MOD) % MOD;
            return dp1[n];
        }
        long long a1 = go(n / 2, 0);
        long long a2 = go(n - n / 2, 1);
        long long b1 = go(n / 2, 1);
        long long b2 = go(n - n / 2, 0);
        dp1[n] = (a1 * a2 % MOD + b1 * b2 % MOD) % MOD;
        return dp1[n];
    }
}

void solve() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long sz = n * m;
    if (sz % 2 == 0) {
        even = (r - l + 1) / 2;
        if ((r - l) % 2 == 0 && l % 2 == 0) even++;
        odd = r - l + 1 - even;
        dp0.clear();
        dp1.clear();
        cout << go(sz, 0) << "\n";
    } else {
        long long ans = pow_mod(r - l + 1, sz);
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int tests = 1;
    // tests can be set to something else if needed
    while (tests--) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
